system: Each plaintext letter is a group of two to four signs (letters, figures and invented signs), with figure groups for letters and syllables (14 = p, 20 = la, 18 = le/de, 30 = m), signs for common words (qui, par, faire, sieur, Monsieur) and nulls between groups.
